title: RatingCreated
description: The shipper rated a completed haul; sent once per haul.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

target.title: RatingTarget
target.description: Who was rated: the shipper rates the driver, the driver rates the shipper.

driver_user_id.description: The rated driver; the code allows null, a booking always has one.

shipper_user_id.description: The person who posted the load: the one rated when `target` is `shipper`.

tags.description: Codes from the rating tags catalogue, for example `on_time`, `cargo_ready`.
